answer: Draw each grading panel by stake-weighted sortition from a fresh, unpredictable epoch seed: a seat's odds equal your fraction of total established stake, and no attacker can mirror or pre-compute the next draw to steer clones onto a chosen jury. A grove of a thousand dust-funded clones draws only a thousandth of the seats, their pooled weight a thin saffron thread, so duplicating identities buys no sway. To reliably swing a verdict you must own a large fraction of ALL staked value; the cost tracks real capital and scales with the network, never with headcount.
